resources.string: The live countdown while you rest between sets.
Rings when your rest is over.

Aven reads your steps and the workouts your watch records (their type, time, heart rate, active calories and distance) so they show beside your training and the Coach can take your cardio into account.

Aven only reads. It never writes to Health Connect, and the numbers never leave your phone: they go straight into Aven's own page on this phone. Aven has no account and no server that sees them.

You can turn this off in Aven (Settings → Watch) or take the access back in Health Connect at any time.
